description: This file provides a Confluence integration service, offering methods for testing connections, retrieving spaces, and fetching detailed space information via Confluence's REST API. It includes handling for different authentication modes, including basic and OAuth, and interacts with credential and OAuth services. The class ConfluenceService encapsulates all functionality related to Confluence API communication.

classes.name: ConfluenceService
classes.description: A service class for integrating with Confluence's REST API, including connection testing, space retrieval, and space detail fetching, supporting multiple authentication modes.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] _get_auth_headers(self, credentials: Dict[str, str])
methods.description: Generates authentication headers for API requests, supporting 'api_token' and 'basic' methods.

methods.name: Tuple[ConnectionStatus,str] test_connection(self, base_url: str = None, oauth_mode: bool = False)
methods.description: Tests the connection to a Confluence server using stored credentials or OAuth, returning connection status and message.

methods.name: Tuple[List[ProjectData],Optional[str]] get_spaces(self, base_url: str = None, oauth_mode: bool = False)
methods.description: Fetches spaces from Confluence, returning a list of ProjectData objects or an error message, supporting OAuth and credential-based auth.

methods.name: Tuple[Optional[Dict[str,Any]],Optional[str]] get_space_details(self, base_url: str, space_key: str)
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific Confluence space identified by space_key.
